text: In 1927 a lynch mob drags the warlock painter Schweick from Room 36 of a New Orleans hotel and kills him in its basement. Decades later, Liza Merrill [inherits the Seven Doors Hotel and moves from New York to reopen it|trigger|making a new home], unaware that it stands over [one of the seven gates of hell|threat|evil places]. A plumber breaks into a bricked-off space in the flooded basement, and soon [the dead begin to walk|threat|the dead that rise], while a [blind woman nobody else in town has seen|rules|only some can see it] begs Liza to leave.
